content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323 If a Category 2 ISR calls GetResource and ends (returns) without calling the corre- sponding ReleaseResource , the Operating System module shall perform the Re- leaseResource call and shall call the ErrorHook (if configured) with the status E_OS_RESOURCE .

If a Category 2 ISR calls GetResource and ends (returns) with- out calling the corresponding ReleaseResource , the Operating System module shall perform the ReleaseResource call and shall call the ErrorHook (if configured) with the status E_OS_RESOURCE (see [12], section 13.1).
